notes.title: Trailer aktualisieren
notes.content:
Thank you for your support. We are about to update a version to address the following issues.
1. In PC mode, the lens may experience black occlusion.
2. When starting in PC mode, Steam VR will start, which reduces the issue of device performance.
3. Bugs in some games lead to abnormal issues.
Once the new version is approved, we will immediately release it. Thank you again.
